items.title: Added forceRemoteSettingsRefresh policy setting: when set, the CLI blocks startup until remote managed settings are freshly fetched, and exits if the…

explanation.what_it_is: The forceRemoteSettingsRefresh policy setting is a new option that, when enabled, forces the CLI to wait for fresh remote managed settings before starting up.
explanation.why_it_matters: This setting ensures that the CLI always uses the latest remote managed settings, which can be particularly important in environments where settings are frequently updated.
how_to_use: Set forceRemoteSettingsRefresh to true in your policy settings to enable the feature
Use this setting in environments where remote managed settings are frequently updated, such as in large-scale deployments

items.title: Added interactive Bedrock setup wizard accessible from the login screen when selecting "3rd-party platform" — guides you through AWS authentication,…

explanation.what_it_is: An interactive Bedrock setup wizard that guides users through AWS authentication when selecting a 3rd-party platform from the login screen.
explanation.why_it_matters: This wizard simplifies the process of setting up Bedrock with AWS, reducing the complexity and potential errors associated with manual configuration.
how_to_use: Select '3rd-party platform' from the login screen to access the wizard
Follow the wizard's prompts to authenticate with AWS and complete the Bedrock setup

items.title: Added per-model and cache-hit breakdown to /cost for subscription users

explanation.what_it_is: The /cost endpoint now provides a breakdown of costs by model and cache hits for subscription users, giving more detailed insights into cost distribution.
explanation.why_it_matters: This change allows subscription users to better understand and optimize their costs by identifying which models are driving expenses and how cache hits are impacting their bills.
how_to_use: Use the /cost endpoint to retrieve a detailed breakdown of your costs, including per-model and cache-hit metrics.
Analyze the breakdown to identify areas where you can optimize model usage and cache hits to reduce costs.

items.title: Added MCP tool result persistence override via _meta["anthropic/maxResultSizeChars"] annotation (up to 500K), allowing larger results like DB schemas…

explanation.what_it_is: The MCP tool now allows result persistence override via a _meta annotation, enabling larger results of up to 500K characters. This is achieved by setting _meta['anthropic/maxResultSizeChars'] to the desired size.
explanation.why_it_matters: This update matters because it allows Claude Code users to work with larger results, such as database schemas, that previously exceeded the character limit. This change enables more complex workflows and larger data processing tasks.
how_to_use: Set _meta['anthropic/maxResultSizeChars'] to 500000 to allow for larger results like DB schemas
Use the annotation to override the default result size limit in MCP tool outputs

items.title: Added disableSkillShellExecution setting to disable inline shell execution in skills, custom slash commands, and plugin commands

explanation.what_it_is: The disableSkillShellExecution setting allows you to disable inline shell execution in skills, custom slash commands, and plugin commands within Claude Code.
explanation.why_it_matters: This setting gives Claude Code users more control over security and execution permissions, allowing them to restrict potentially risky shell execution in specific contexts.
how_to_use: Set disableSkillShellExecution to true in your configuration to prevent skills and custom commands from executing shell commands inline.
Use this setting to enforce security policies in environments where shell execution poses a risk.

items.title: Added support for multi-line prompts in claude-cli://open?q= deep links (encoded newlines %0A no longer rejected)

explanation.what_it_is: The ability to use multi-line prompts in claude-cli://open?q= deep links by encoding newlines as %0A, which are no longer rejected.
explanation.why_it_matters: This update allows Claude Code users to create more complex and formatted prompts when opening links, enabling more precise and detailed queries.
how_to_use: Use %0A to encode newlines in your prompts, such as 'prompt line 1%0Aprompt line 2'
Create multi-line prompts in claude-cli://open?q= deep links to test and refine your queries

items.title: Added /powerup — interactive lessons teaching Claude Code features with animated demos

explanation.what_it_is: The /powerup command provides interactive lessons with animated demos to teach Claude Code features.
explanation.why_it_matters: This update allows users to learn Claude Code features in a more engaging and visual way, potentially reducing the time it takes to get familiar with the platform.
how_to_use: Type /powerup to access the interactive lessons and start learning Claude Code features.
Use the animated demos to understand how to apply specific features in your workflow.

items.title: Added CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_KEEP_MARKETPLACE_ON_FAILURE env var to keep the existing marketplace cache when git pull fails, useful in offline…

explanation.what_it_is: The CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_KEEP_MARKETPLACE_ON_FAILURE environment variable allows you to preserve the existing marketplace cache when a git pull operation fails. This variable is particularly useful in offline or unstable network environments.
explanation.why_it_matters: By keeping the marketplace cache intact, you can avoid having to re-download or re-install plugins when a git pull fails, saving time and reducing frustration. This is especially important in offline environments where re-downloading plugins may not be possible.
how_to_use: Set the CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_KEEP_MARKETPLACE_ON_FAILURE environment variable to 'true' to enable this feature
Use this variable in conjunction with git pull to preserve the marketplace cache in case of a failure

items.title: Added .husky to protected directories (acceptEdits mode)

explanation.what_it_is: The .husky directory is now protected from accidental edits or deletions when acceptEdits mode is enabled in Claude Code.
explanation.why_it_matters: This change helps prevent unintended modifications to husky hooks, which can disrupt automated workflows and Git version control processes.
how_to_use: Enable acceptEdits mode to safeguard .husky directories from unwanted changes
Verify that .husky is listed in protected directories to ensure hooks remain intact

items.title: Added "defer" permission decision to PreToolUse hooks — headless sessions can pause at a tool call and resume with -p --resume to have the hook…

explanation.what_it_is: The 'defer' permission decision allows PreToolUse hooks to pause headless sessions at a tool call, enabling resumption with the --resume flag.
explanation.why_it_matters: This change enables more fine-grained control over headless sessions, allowing for more flexible automation workflows.
how_to_use: Use the 'defer' decision in a PreToolUse hook to pause a headless session at a specific tool call.
Resume the paused session with the -p --resume flag to continue execution.

items.title: Added CLAUDE_CODE_NO_FLICKER=1 environment variable to opt into flicker-free alt-screen rendering with virtualized scrollback

explanation.what_it_is: The CLAUDE_CODE_NO_FLICKER=1 environment variable allows users to opt into flicker-free rendering of alternate screens with virtualized scrollback in Claude Code.
explanation.why_it_matters: This update reduces screen flicker when using alternate screens, making for a smoother user experience, especially in situations where virtualized scrollback is utilized.
how_to_use: Set the CLAUDE_CODE_NO_FLICKER=1 environment variable before launching Claude Code to enable flicker-free rendering.
Use this feature in conjunction with virtualized scrollback to minimize visual distractions.

items.title: Added PermissionDenied hook that fires after auto mode classifier denials — return {retry: true} to tell the model it can retry

explanation.what_it_is: The PermissionDenied hook is a new event that triggers after the auto mode classifier denies a request, allowing developers to intervene in the decision-making process. It can be used to retry the denied request by returning {retry: true}.
explanation.why_it_matters: This hook gives developers more control over the auto mode classifier's decisions, enabling them to handle denied requests in a more customized way. By retrying denied requests, developers can potentially increase the accuracy of their models.
how_to_use: Return {retry: true} from the PermissionDenied hook to retry a denied request
Use the hook to log denied requests for further analysis and debugging

items.title: Added named subagents to @ mention typeahead suggestions

explanation.what_it_is: Named subagents are now included in the typeahead suggestions when using the @ mention feature in Claude Code, allowing for more specific and targeted mentions.
explanation.why_it_matters: This update enables Claude Code users to more easily and accurately mention specific subagents in their code, reducing errors and improving collaboration.
how_to_use: Type @ in the code editor to trigger typeahead suggestions, then select a named subagent from the list
Use named subagents in @ mentions to clarify and specify the intended recipient or reference

items.title: Added MCP_CONNECTION_NONBLOCKING=true for -p mode to skip the MCP connection wait entirely, and bounded --mcp-config server connections at 5s instead…

explanation.what_it_is: The MCP_CONNECTION_NONBLOCKING=true flag allows Claude Code to skip waiting for an MCP connection when running in -p mode, and limits --mcp-config server connections to 5 seconds.
explanation.why_it_matters: This update reduces the time spent waiting for MCP connections, making Claude Code more responsive in certain workflows.
how_to_use: Run Claude Code with -p mode and MCP_CONNECTION_NONBLOCKING=true to skip MCP connection waits
Use --mcp-config with a timeout of 5 seconds or less to bound server connection times

items.title: We've raised the max_tokens cap to 300k on the Message Batches API for Claude…
items.summary: We've raised the max_tokens cap to 300k on the Message Batches API for Claude Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6. Include the output-300k-2026-03-24 beta header to generate longer single-turn outputs for…

explanation.what_it_is: The max_tokens cap on the Message Batches API for Claude has been increased to 300,000, allowing for longer single-turn outputs.
explanation.why_it_matters: This change enables Claude Code users to generate more extensive and detailed responses, particularly useful for applications requiring longer-form text outputs.
how_to_use: Include the output-300k-2026-03-24 beta header in API requests to generate longer outputs
Use the updated API to process larger batches of text data with Claude Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6

items.title: We're retiring the 1M token context window beta for Claude Sonnet 4.5 and…
items.summary: We're retiring the 1M token context window beta for Claude Sonnet 4.5 and Claude Sonnet 4 on April 30, 2026. After that date, requests that include the context-1m-2025-08-07 beta header on these…

explanation.what_it_is: The 1M token context window beta is being retired for Claude Sonnet 4.5 and Claude Sonnet 4, meaning that requests with the context-1m-2025-08-07 beta header will no longer be supported after April 30, 2026.
explanation.why_it_matters: This change affects users who have been using the 1M token context window beta, as they will need to update their requests to remove the beta header to avoid errors after the retirement date.
how_to_use: Remove the context-1m-2025-08-07 beta header from requests to Claude Sonnet 4.5 and Claude Sonnet 4
Update existing code to handle the removal of the 1M token context window beta

items.title: Added X-Claude-Code-Session-Id header to API requests so proxies can aggregate requests by session without parsing the body

explanation.what_it_is: The X-Claude-Code-Session-Id header is now included in API requests, allowing proxies to identify and group requests by session.
explanation.why_it_matters: This change enables proxies to aggregate requests by session without needing to parse the request body, simplifying logging and analytics.
how_to_use: Use the X-Claude-Code-Session-Id header to track user sessions in your proxy logs
Configure your proxy to group requests by the X-Claude-Code-Session-Id header for easier analytics

items.title: Added .jj and .sl to VCS directory exclusion lists so Grep and file autocomplete don't descend into Jujutsu or Sapling metadata

explanation.what_it_is: The .jj and .sl directories, used by Jujutsu and Sapling metadata, are now excluded from version control system (VCS) directory searches. This exclusion applies to Grep and file autocomplete operations.
explanation.why_it_matters: This change prevents unnecessary searches and suggestions, improving the relevance and speed of Grep results and file autocomplete suggestions within Claude Code.
how_to_use: Run Grep commands without inadvertently searching Jujutsu or Sapling metadata directories
Use file autocomplete to quickly find relevant files, without suggestions from .jj and .sl directories

items.title: Added CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_SERVER_NAME and CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_SERVER_URL environment variables to MCP headersHelper scripts, allowing one helper to serve…

explanation.what_it_is: Two new environment variables, CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_SERVER_NAME and CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_SERVER_URL, have been added to MCP headersHelper scripts, enabling a single helper to serve multiple servers.
explanation.why_it_matters: This update allows for more flexibility in managing multiple servers with a single helper script, reducing the need for duplicate scripts.
how_to_use: Set CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_SERVER_NAME and CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_SERVER_URL environment variables to specify the server name and URL for your helper script.
Use a single helper script to manage multiple servers by switching between different environment variable values.

items.title: Added conditional if field for hooks using permission rule syntax (e.g., Bash(git *)) to filter when they run, reducing process spawning overhead

explanation.what_it_is: A conditional if field for hooks that uses permission rule syntax to filter when they run, allowing for more targeted hook execution.
explanation.why_it_matters: This update reduces process spawning overhead by only running hooks when specific conditions are met, resulting in more efficient workflow execution.
how_to_use: Use Bash(git *) syntax to specify conditions under which hooks should run, such as only running a hook when a git command is executed.
Configure hooks to run conditionally based on specific permissions or commands, reducing unnecessary hook executions.

items.title: Added timestamp markers in transcripts when scheduled tasks (/loop, CronCreate) fire

explanation.what_it_is: Timestamp markers are now added to transcripts when scheduled tasks, such as /loop and CronCreate, are executed.
explanation.why_it_matters: This update allows Claude Code users to track when automated tasks are run, making it easier to monitor and debug their workflows.
how_to_use: Use the timestamp markers to identify when a scheduled task was executed in a transcript
Compare the timestamps to troubleshoot issues with automated tasks

items.title: Added trailing space after [Image #N] placeholder when pasting images

explanation.what_it_is: When pasting images into Claude Code, a trailing space is now automatically added after the [Image #N] placeholder.
explanation.why_it_matters: This change helps maintain consistent formatting and prevents images from running into adjacent text, making it easier to read and edit documents.
how_to_use: Paste an image into a Claude Code document to see the trailing space added after the placeholder
Use this feature to ensure proper spacing between images and text in your documents

items.title: Added PowerShell tool for Windows as an opt-in preview. Learn more at https://code.claude.com/docs/en/tools-reference#powershell-tool

explanation.what_it_is: The PowerShell tool is a new opt-in preview feature for Windows users, allowing them to utilize PowerShell within Claude Code.
explanation.why_it_matters: This addition enables Windows users to leverage PowerShell's capabilities, such as automating tasks and executing scripts, directly within Claude Code.
how_to_use: Opt-in to the PowerShell tool preview through the Claude Code settings
Use the PowerShell tool to run scripts and automate tasks on Windows
Refer to the tools reference documentation at https://code.claude.com/docs/en/tools-reference#powershell-tool for more information

items.title: Added ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_{OPUS,SONNET,HAIKU}_MODEL_SUPPORTS env vars to override effort/thinking capability detection for pinned default models for 3p…

explanation.what_it_is: The ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_{OPUS,SONNET,HAIKU}_MODEL_SUPPORTS environment variables allow you to override the default effort and thinking capability detection for pinned models.
explanation.why_it_matters: This update gives Claude Code users more control over model behavior, particularly when working with third-party models, by enabling them to manually specify the capabilities of their default models.
how_to_use: Set ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL_SUPPORTS to override the default OPUS model capabilities
Set ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL_SUPPORTS to override the default SONNET model capabilities
Set ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL_SUPPORTS to override the default HAIKU model capabilities

items.title: Added CLAUDE_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS env var to configure the streaming idle watchdog threshold (default 90s)

explanation.what_it_is: The CLAUDE_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS environment variable allows you to configure the threshold for the streaming idle watchdog, which determines how long a stream can be idle before it is considered inactive.
explanation.why_it_matters: This update gives Claude Code users more control over the streaming idle timeout, allowing them to adjust the threshold to suit their specific use cases and avoid unnecessary stream closures.
how_to_use: Set CLAUDE_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS to a higher value (e.g., 300000) to increase the idle timeout for long-running streams
Set CLAUDE_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS to a lower value (e.g., 30000) to decrease the idle timeout for streams that require more frequent activity

items.title: Added TaskCreated hook that fires when a task is created via TaskCreate

explanation.what_it_is: The TaskCreated hook is a new event trigger in Claude Code that activates when a task is created using the TaskCreate function.
explanation.why_it_matters: This hook allows developers to execute custom code or workflows immediately after a new task is created, enabling automated reactions to task creation events.
how_to_use: Use the TaskCreated hook to send notifications to team members when a new task is assigned to them.
Implement custom logging or analytics when tasks are created to track project activity.

items.title: Added WorktreeCreate hook support for type: "http" — return the created worktree path via hookSpecificOutput.worktreePath in the response JSON

explanation.what_it_is: The WorktreeCreate hook now supports type 'http', allowing you to create a worktree and receive the created worktree path in the response JSON.
explanation.why_it_matters: This update enables Claude Code users to automate worktree creation over HTTP and retrieve the created worktree path for further processing or integration with other tools.
how_to_use: Use the WorktreeCreate hook with type 'http' to create a worktree and retrieve the created path
Access the created worktree path via the hookSpecificOutput.worktreePath field in the response JSON

items.title: Added allowedChannelPlugins managed setting for team/enterprise admins to define a channel plugin allowlist

explanation.what_it_is: The allowedChannelPlugins managed setting allows team and enterprise admins to define a list of approved channel plugins that can be used within their organization.
explanation.why_it_matters: This setting gives admins control over which channel plugins are allowed, enabling them to enforce security and compliance policies within their team or enterprise.
how_to_use: Define a list of approved channel plugins in the allowedChannelPlugins setting
Use this setting to restrict access to specific plugins for security or compliance reasons

items.title: Added x-client-request-id header to API requests for debugging timeouts

explanation.what_it_is: The x-client-request-id header is now included in API requests made by Claude Code, providing a unique identifier for each request.
explanation.why_it_matters: This addition facilitates debugging of timeouts by allowing users to track and identify specific requests that are timing out.
how_to_use: Include the x-client-request-id header in API request logs to correlate requests with timeout errors
Use the x-client-request-id to identify and retry failed requests

items.title: Added idle-return prompt that nudges users returning after 75+ minutes to /clear, reducing unnecessary token re-caching on stale sessions

explanation.what_it_is: A prompt that appears when a user returns to Claude Code after 75+ minutes of inactivity, suggesting they run the /clear command to reset their session.
explanation.why_it_matters: This reduces unnecessary token re-caching on stale sessions, which can help prevent issues with outdated session data.
how_to_use: When prompted, run the /clear command to reset your session and avoid potential issues with stale data.
Use this prompt as a reminder to regularly clear your session when working with sensitive or frequently updated data.

items.title: [VSCode] Added rate limit warning banner with usage percentage and reset time

explanation.what_it_is: A rate limit warning banner in VSCode that displays the current usage percentage and reset time.
explanation.why_it_matters: This banner helps Claude Code users in VSCode track their rate limit usage and plan accordingly to avoid hitting the limit, reducing the likelihood of interrupted workflows.
how_to_use: Monitor the banner to stay aware of your current usage percentage
Plan your tasks around the reset time to minimize disruptions

items.title: Added managed-settings.d/ drop-in directory alongside managed-settings.json, letting separate teams deploy independent policy fragments that merge…

explanation.what_it_is: A new drop-in directory called managed-settings.d/ that allows separate teams to deploy independent policy fragments, which merge with the existing managed-settings.json file.
explanation.why_it_matters: This update enables multiple teams to manage their own policy settings independently, without having to coordinate changes to a single file, making it easier to manage complex configurations.
how_to_use: Create a new file in the managed-settings.d/ directory to define a policy fragment specific to your team
Use this file to override or extend settings defined in the main managed-settings.json file

items.title: Added CwdChanged and FileChanged hook events for reactive environment management (e.g., direnv)

explanation.what_it_is: The CwdChanged and FileChanged hook events allow Claude Code to detect changes in the current working directory and file system, enabling reactive environment management.
explanation.why_it_matters: This update enables Claude Code users to automate tasks and manage their environment in response to changes in the file system, such as when using direnv.
how_to_use: Use the CwdChanged event to trigger actions when the current working directory changes
Use the FileChanged event to trigger actions when a file is modified or updated

items.title: Added sandbox.failIfUnavailable setting to exit with an error when sandbox is enabled but cannot start, instead of running unsandboxed

explanation.what_it_is: The sandbox.failIfUnavailable setting allows Claude Code to exit with an error when the sandbox is enabled but cannot start, preventing the application from running unsandboxed.
explanation.why_it_matters: This setting ensures that Claude Code maintains its sandboxed environment, preventing potential security risks when the sandbox cannot be initialized.
how_to_use: Set sandbox.failIfUnavailable to true in your configuration to enable this behavior
Use this setting in environments where sandboxing is required for security or compliance reasons

items.title: Added disableDeepLinkRegistration setting to prevent claude-cli:// protocol handler registration

explanation.what_it_is: The disableDeepLinkRegistration setting prevents the registration of the claude-cli:// protocol handler, which is used to handle deep links in Claude Code.
explanation.why_it_matters: This setting gives users control over whether Claude Code registers the protocol handler, which can be useful in environments where such registrations are not desired or are restricted.
how_to_use: Set disableDeepLinkRegistration to true in your configuration to prevent the claude-cli:// protocol handler from being registered.
Use this setting on platforms where protocol handler registration is not allowed or is unwanted.

items.title: Added CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB=1 to strip Anthropic and cloud provider credentials from subprocess environments (Bash tool, hooks, MCP stdio…

explanation.what_it_is: A new environment variable CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB=1 that removes Anthropic and cloud provider credentials from subprocess environments in Claude Code.
explanation.why_it_matters: This update helps prevent accidental exposure of sensitive credentials when running subprocesses, such as Bash tools or hooks, in Claude Code.
how_to_use: Set CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB=1 in your environment to enable credential stripping for subprocesses.
Use this variable in conjunction with Bash tools or hooks to ensure credentials are removed from subprocess environments.

items.title: Added transcript search — press / in transcript mode (Ctrl+O) to search, n/N to step through matches

explanation.what_it_is: Transcript search allows you to find specific text within a transcript by pressing / in transcript mode, with Ctrl+O as a shortcut. This enables a search function within the transcript.
explanation.why_it_matters: This update streamlines the process of locating specific parts of a transcript, saving time for Claude Code users who need to review or reference particular sections. It simplifies navigation within transcripts.
how_to_use: Press / in transcript mode to initiate a search
Use Ctrl+O as a shortcut to start searching
Press n/N to step through search matches

items.title: Added Ctrl+X Ctrl+E as an alias for opening the external editor (readline-native binding; Ctrl+G still works)

explanation.what_it_is: A new keyboard shortcut, Ctrl+X Ctrl+E, that opens the external editor in Claude Code, in addition to the existing Ctrl+G shortcut.
explanation.why_it_matters: This update provides an alternative way to access the external editor, which may be more familiar or convenient for some users, particularly those accustomed to readline-native bindings.
how_to_use: Press Ctrl+X Ctrl+E to open the external editor from within Claude Code
Use Ctrl+G as an alternative shortcut to achieve the same result

items.title: Deprecated TaskOutput tool in favor of using Read on the background task's output file path

explanation.what_it_is: The TaskOutput tool has been deprecated, and users are now expected to use the Read function to access the output file path of a background task.
explanation.why_it_matters: This change requires users to update their workflows to use the Read function, which provides a more direct way to access task output.
how_to_use: Replace TaskOutput with Read('/path/to/background/task/output') in your code
Update your task output handling to use the Read function's file path parameter

Use the capabilities object to determine which models support specific features or tasks
